title: Aqua-world: Umi Monogatari
native_title: アクアワールド ～海美物語～
overview:
The game focuses on marine life in the sea. The player can access three different segments:

• Data Fish: Shows photos, facts and 3D models of fish and sea mammals.
• Mermaid: The player can simulate the life of a marine animal in an ocean environment or aquarium.
• Electric Blue: There are several interactive cinematic sequences of sea creatures swimming in the ocean.
